images.article_title: Bitcoin menuju November terburuk sejak 2018, ETF keluar $4,14 miliar
images.image_prompt: A giant cracked glass-and-steel vault in an empty stock-exchange hall at dusk, a huge golden Bitcoin disc split by a jagged crack at its center, molten gold streaming out of the crack like water from a burst dam across a dark marble floor, cold red emergency light washing the hall while a few dim green glints fade in the far background — the image shows institutional money draining out of Bitcoin in its worst November since 2018. Fire-red accent (negative sentiment), no people, no text/numbers/logos (v3.1).

Fire-red accent (negative sentiment), no people, no text/numbers/logos (v3.1).

images.article_title: Bitcoin Strategy 22% di bawah harga beli, Schiff ramal bakal 'meledak'
images.image_prompt: A vast marble corporate treasury hall at night; a giant golden Bitcoin, at least 40% of the frame wide, sinking below a glowing red waterline that cuts diagonally across the hall — the waterline marks the average cost the company paid, the coin sits beneath it. In the right foreground, Peter Schiff, a recognizable grey-haired man in a dark suit, stands at the edge of the water gesturing toward the sinking coin. Fire-red volumetric light, wet marble reflections, a few gold coins resting on the dry floor above the line. The sinking coin is the dominant hero; the scene reads in one second: a corporate Bitcoin fortune underwater. Fire-red accent (negative sentiment), no text/numbers/logos (v3.1).

images.article_title: Cramer: kejatuhan saham AI bukan 2000, S&P 500 masuk koreksi
images.image_prompt: A television studio at night bathed in fire-red light; Jim Cramer, a recognizable grey-haired host in a dark suit, stands behind a curved anchor desk facing the camera, gesturing with open hands as if explaining the market. Behind him, a giant glowing AI computer chip, at least 40% of the frame wide, tilts sharply downward as if sliding, trailing red light — the visual of AI shares falling. The tilting chip is the dominant hero behind the host; the scene reads in one second: the face of the market debate as AI stocks slide. Fire-red accent (negative sentiment), no text/numbers/logos (v3.1).
